principles.envelopeIsTheRhythm: Every channel (touch, light, tone) renders the identical envelope. What the hand feels, the eye sees and the ear hears.
principles.severityIsIntensity: Severity NEVER changes a rhythm, only its strength/brightness/volume. A learned rhythm is identical at every severity.
principles.allClearIsSilence: The all-clear plays nothing on any channel. A quiet device means safe.
principles.mimetic: Every rhythm is the hazard's own temporal signature, converging with the iconicity of sign languages. Future patterns MUST be mimetic.
principles.photosensitivity: Light renderers never exceed 3 flashes per second (WCAG 2.3.1) or 6 state transitions per second, and MUST offer a steady-light path for users who identify as photosensitive.
principles.repetition: Urgent alerts repeat the full pattern back to back, with no pause, until the person acknowledges.
principles.fallback: A device that cannot render a pattern falls back to its platform's common cadence, never to silence.

GROUND.mimesis: The ground does not pause: one long unbroken hold, like the sustained-shaking signs for earthquake. Nothing else is unbroken.

WATER.mimesis: A wave swells, travels, hits: two long soft rolls, like the rolling hand motion of the signs for waves.

STORM.mimesis: Wind arrives in gusts that slam: three sharp knocks.

FIRE.mimesis: Flames flicker fast: ten rapid pulses, like the fingers of the sign for fire flickering upward. Nothing else is this fast. 2.5 flashes per second, inside the 3 per second bound.

THREAT.meaning: danger from people (attack, active threat, missing child)
THREAT.mimesis: A human threat announces itself: one hard knock at the door, one long push, five rapid fires, then silence. A sequence nothing natural makes.

TEST.meaning: test or drill, never a real emergency
TEST.mimesis: A gentle shoulder tap, twice, far apart: checking, not warning. A drill must never feel like an emergency.

OTHER.meaning: any hazard outside the named families (health, chemical, infrastructure)
OTHER.mimesis: Three steady calls, evenly spaced: attention without imitation, reserved for what has no shape of its own.

severity.rule: Level scales channel intensity (vibration strength, light brightness, tone volume). It never alters pulses. Color must never carry severity alone: pair it with the mark count and the felt intensity.
